parameters: A thin grey man in the Order's black coat is
standing at the great map with a fistful of pins,
reading it the way other people read a will.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Chapter House of the Order of
the Errant. Mordaunt, clerk.
Are you a knight?
You say that you grow turnips.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Then you are not on the map.
Good. One knight, one pin.
That is the system.
You look at the map. There are a great many
white pins in it, one to a knight, and nine red.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Sir Aldric Pemberton-Gore.
The Third. Nine pins.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Six of them are correct,
on different dates. Three of
them are the same week.
You ask how a man can be in three places in
one week.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] That is a question for the
committee. The committee has
been formed. It is reviewing
the map, the pins and the week.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] People say the Order has lost
his file. The Order has not
lost his file.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] The Order has nine of them.
He takes a tenth pin from his fist. He holds
it over the island for a long moment, and then
he puts it back.
Mordaunt looks up from the map, at the knight
behind you, and back at the map.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Mordaunt! Splendid fellow.
Where am I?
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Frostwick, sir. And Fenmarch.
And a lay-by in the west.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Busy week.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] The committee will write.
A
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] If you should see Sir Aldric,
note the place, the date and
the time. In ink. Not pencil.
Pencil is how we got here.
Mordaunt looks up from the map, sees Sir Aldric, and puts
his fistful of pins down on the desk, very carefully, as
if they might go off.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Sir Aldric. It is Thursday.
The committee will see you now.
He crosses to the committee's table and sits in the first
chair. Then he gets up and sits in the second, and then
on each of the stools. Then he stands behind them all.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Is it just you, Mordaunt?
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] It is the committee, sir. I have
been appointed to it four times.
We are quorate.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Finding one: nine pins. Finding
two: all nine are correct. Finding
three: three of them are the same
week.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] The committee has been unable to
fault the pins. It has therefore
had to fault the knight.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Entirely fair.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Recommendation: that Sir Aldric be
requested to REMAIN IN ONE PLACE
for the duration of the review.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] You are so requested, sir.
Informed. In ink.
Sir Aldric goes very still. In six years of trying to
leave Thistlewick, nobody has ever once asked him to
stay anywhere.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] And the committee is empowered to
offer: Knight Commander of the
Chapter. A desk. Here. A pin that
does not move.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Contingent on remaining in
one place.
It is the one thing he cannot do, and the one thing he
has always wanted to be asked. Everybody in the room can
see both of those at once, including the knight.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Mordaunt. That is the finest thing
I have been offered in nine years.
Thank you.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] No.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] A knight who stays put is a post.
Dame Winifred is a very fine post,
and she is happy, and I honour her.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] I should be at that desk by nine
every morning. And I should never
once find it twice.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] But you asked. Nobody asks a man to
stay. Put that in the minutes, would
you? In ink.
Mordaunt writes for some time. Then he reads it back to
himself, and crosses nothing out, which the ledger on his
desk would tell you is a first.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Then the committee has a data
problem, sir. The knight cannot
stay with the pin.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Resolved: that the pin go
with the knight.
He goes along the great map and takes out the nine red
pins one at a time, and puts eight of them in the heap on
his desk. The ninth he holds out.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Knight Errant, At Large. A rank of
the Order, created this Thursday.
The pin goes with the knight.
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] And wherever the knight is, sir,
the map is correct. That is the
system now.
Sir Aldric pins it to his tabard, over the knight who is
facing the wrong way, and stands up very straight.
Actor3
\C[6]Aldric:\C[0] Splendid fellow.
Knight Errant, At Large
Sir Aldric is now \C[3]Knight Errant, At Large\C[0].
Gen_People3
\C[6]Mordaunt:\C[0] Sir Aldric is wherever he is. He
has the pin. The map is correct.
That is the system.
He has very few red pins left to move, and does not seem
to know what to do with his hands.

The island, in the Order's own survey, four sheets
wide, with a pin for every knight in the field.
One pin, one knight: a white head for each of
them, spread thin, standing where they were put.
And nine red ones, all over it, for one knight,
three of which have a label in the same hand:
SAME WEEK. SEE COMMITTEE.

volume, each one thin and neat and in its place.

A sheet of paper with pins laid out on it, sorted
by colour: a great many white, and a small heap
of red, kept apart.
The ledger beside it is open at P. Every entry
on the page has been crossed out and written
in again somewhere else.
Three paces behind Sir Aldric, as near as he can manage,
stands the Fourth, pretending to look at something else.

\C[6]The Fourth:\C[0] Mordaunt asked where Uncle was.
I said: here. He wrote it down
and looked so pleased.
